name: Client
title: Client request
summary: Browsers, apps and services open TLS connections and send requests. Every request begins here and is traced end to end.

name: Server Load Balancer
title: Edge load balancing
summary: The managed load balancer terminates the public edge, spreads connections across healthy proxy nodes and absorbs bursts before traffic reaches the platform.

name: HAProxy (primary)
title: HAProxy primary
summary: The active layer-4/7 proxy holds the floating virtual IP, performs health checks and forwards traffic to the web tier.

name: HAProxy (backup)
title: HAProxy backup
summary: A hot standby watches the primary through VRRP. If heartbeats stop, it claims the floating IP within seconds, so failover is nearly invisible.

name: NGINX
title: NGINX web tier
summary: Serves static assets, applies rate limits and caching, and reverse-proxies dynamic requests to the API gateway.

name: Kong API Gateway
title: API gateway
summary: Routes API calls, authenticates tokens, enforces rate limits and applies plugins so individual services stay small and focused.

name: Istio Service Mesh
title: Service mesh
summary: Wraps every pod in a sidecar proxy that provides mutual TLS, traffic shifting, retries and telemetry without changing application code.

name: Service Pods
title: Kubernetes workloads
summary: Stateless microservices run as pods on Kubernetes, scaled and rolled out through GitOps pipelines and health probes.

name: Kafka
title: Event streaming
summary: A durable, partitioned log decouples producers from consumers so services exchange events asynchronously and can replay history.

name: Redis
title: In-memory cache
summary: Keeps hot data, sessions and counters in memory for sub-millisecond reads, shielding the database from repeated lookups.

name: PostgreSQL
title: Relational store
summary: The system of record for transactional data, with replication, backups and point-in-time recovery for durability.

name: Prometheus
title: Metrics
summary: Scrapes metrics from every layer, stores time series and evaluates alerting rules that drive SLO and error-budget tracking.

name: Grafana
title: Dashboards
summary: Turns metrics, logs and traces into shared dashboards so teams see latency, saturation and errors in one place.

name: Loki
title: Log aggregation
summary: Indexes logs by labels and stores them cheaply, letting engineers pivot from a metric spike to the exact log lines.
